statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The service was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before the service was rendered.
